note: Hand-made line set (JS 2026-09-27). The Master narrates. at = seconds into the shot, t = seconds into the movie, dur = slot.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Once upon a time, the strongest wizard who|ever lived ruled the world.
lines.text: Once upon a time, the strongest wizard who ever lived ruled the world.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: They called him only the Master. For a thousand|years, he kept the peace.
lines.text: They called him only the Master. For a thousand years, he kept the peace.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: His citadel rose above the clouds, a city of|towers, bridges and bells.
lines.text: His citadel rose above the clouds, a city of towers, bridges and bells.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Dragons great and small filled its sky, and not|one breathed in anger.
lines.text: Dragons great and small filled its sky, and not one breathed in anger.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Kings brought him their quarrels, and went home|as friends.
lines.text: Kings brought him their quarrels, and went home as friends.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: He raised four apprentices, and gave each of|them a kingdom.
lines.text: He raised four apprentices, and gave each of them a kingdom.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Then, between one breath and the next, he was|gone.
lines.text: Then, between one breath and the next, he was gone.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Vessa, of Fire.
lines.text: Vessa, of Fire.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Malrik, of Shadow.
lines.text: Malrik, of Shadow.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Torvald, of Ice.
lines.text: Torvald, of Ice.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Ysolde, of Nature.
lines.text: Ysolde, of Nature.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Four heirs. One empty throne.
lines.text: Four heirs. One empty throne.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: I know this tale well, child. I was that wizard.
lines.text: I know this tale well, child. I was that wizard.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Vessa, the youngest. She lit her first spark|before she could spell her name.
lines.text: Vessa, the youngest. She lit her first spark before she could spell her name.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Give her a wall, and she will burn a door|through it.
lines.text: Give her a wall, and she will burn a door through it.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: But she never waits. And fire that will not wait|burns its own house.
lines.text: But she never waits. And fire that will not wait burns its own house.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Still, she laughed like sunrise. Vessa was my|joy.
lines.text: Still, she laughed like sunrise. Vessa was my joy.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Malrik. I found him reading tombstones by the|light of one candle.
lines.text: Malrik. I found him reading tombstones by the light of one candle.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Nothing is hidden from him. The dark itself|comes when he calls.
lines.text: Nothing is hidden from him. The dark itself comes when he calls.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: But he is never full. Whatever he holds, he|wants more.
lines.text: But he is never full. Whatever he holds, he wants more.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: He thinks I gave him leftovers. I gave the dark|to the one it could not frighten.
lines.text: He thinks I gave him leftovers. I gave the dark to the one it could not frighten.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Torvald, the eldest. Where he stands, the ice|holds, and so does the line.
lines.text: Torvald, the eldest. Where he stands, the ice holds, and so does the line.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Armies have not broken him, nor winters,|nor time.
lines.text: Armies have not broken him, nor winters, nor time.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: But he waits too long, and trusts slow ice more|than quick friends.
lines.text: But he waits too long, and trusts slow ice more than quick friends.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: I left him my coldest secret. Torvald was my|patience.
lines.text: I left him my coldest secret. Torvald was my patience.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Ysolde. I found her coaxing a sapling through|the frost.
lines.text: Ysolde. I found her coaxing a sapling through the frost.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Burn her forest down, and it grows back. Every|spring. Every time.
lines.text: Burn her forest down, and it grows back. Every spring. Every time.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: But she will not take a side, not even while the|world burns.
lines.text: But she will not take a side, not even while the world burns.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: I would say: show me again. And she always did.|Ysolde was my heart.
lines.text: I would say: show me again. And she always did. Ysolde was my heart.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: I loved all four of them. And still, they went|to war.
lines.text: I loved all four of them. And still, they went to war.
